goals.objective: Allow only genuinely immutable system config fallback while retaining writable lock and rewrite race defenses and complete bounded inventories.

successCriteria.scenario: Reject owner-controlled and drifting config while allowing the actual immutable macOS system config.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Go TempDir fixtures removed; external system config read only.

successCriteria.scenario: Parse all three >4096-byte config inventories completely and fail closed above 1 MiB without partial results.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Fake Git and inventory TempDir fixtures removed.

successCriteria.scenario: Keep existing writable config lock collision and rewrite-race regressions green.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Lock, script, marker, and repository TempDir fixtures removed.

goals.title: Use immutable implementation evidence
goals.objective: Prefer valid branch_prepare.base_sha over moving refs without breaking legacy records.

successCriteria.scenario: Retain implementation evidence after origin/main moves, reject unchanged HEAD, and preserve malformed/missing SHA fallback.
successCriteria.cleanupReceipt: Temporary Git repository removed by Go TempDir cleanup.
